parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

Default value: en.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz describe-resolver-rule --lang en --rule-id hr0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz DescribeResolverRule --region cn-hangzhou --RuleId hr0000 --Lang en
